title: MY OPINIONAND SUGGESTIONS
body:
I LOVEE this app sooo much. if ur thinking of becoming more productive this is a great help (from my experience at least) HOWEEVERRRR I have suggestions for the creator of the app that in my opinion, will make it more fun
 1. let me rearrange the furniture around and put it wherever I want to put it.

2. Make the cats/dogs. I can buy with carrots move around not just sitting down all the time

3. don’t auto determine my mood to “😐” AND GIVE ME MORE MOODS (make them free lmao)

4. Why can i place my rabbit in mid air 😭😭 the proportions dont add up. Make him smaller when put far way and i want to be able to makw it sit down on chairs and stuff

5. DIFFERENT TV CHANELS WOULD BE SO COOL
 
6. Night time in the garden 

And finally, i think this app is absolutely genius and soo easy to use so literally anyone could use it 
I ❤️ habbit rabbit
author: Lynno.sAlaMeH ..
